== Biography ==
Deaths in the district of Rockhampton, 2nd July 1908,  Corner of Ross & Gladstone Streets, Rockhampton, John Glasgow, Butcher, male 68yrs, Influenza, Heart failure, Dr. H. E Brown, 01 July 1908, Father; William Glasgow, farmer, Mother; Mary Henery, Informant; William James Glasgow, son, Gladstone Street. buried 3rd July Rockhampton Cemetery, Religion; Methodist. Where born; Tyrone, lived in Australia about 32 years, married Mary Jane Murphy in Cookstown age 28, issue living; William James 38yr, issue dead. 1 male
A marriage for John Glasgow and Murphy was registered on 18 December 1866 in the Cookstown district.<ref>[https://geni.nidirect.gov.uk/search/marriage GRONI civil marriage index], 18 December 1866, Cookstown district, M/1866/L1/1132/1/157.</ref>

== Research Notes ==

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.
